title: DECSET 1034 — Interpret '8-bit' C1 controls
summary: CSI ? 1034 h enables 8-bit control characters (C1 controls like 0x80-0x9F are interpreted). CSI ? 1034 l disables it (C1 controls are ignored).

frame.note: DEC private modes are CSI sequences with a leading '?' (0x3F) private-parameter prefix. Set = final byte 'h' (DECSET); reset = final byte 'l' (DECRST).

terminator_detail.note: No string terminator: a DEC private mode is a CSI sequence ending at its final byte ('h' to set, 'l' to reset).

gotchas: 8-bit mode allows single-byte C1 controls (0x80-0x9F) instead of ESC + 7-bit equivalents.
8-bit mode is rare in modern terminals.

v1_smoke_test.asserts: DECSET/DECRST 1034 render as byte-exact CSI ? 1034 h/l sequences.
